subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Confidence must eventually meet another human being.”?
options: Communication is more than correct answers; it is connection under pressure.
A building that once divided people can later teach them about connection.
It is affected by design, habits, stress, and social pressure.
Information shared responsibly can help communities ask better questions and demand better answers.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「Confidence must eventually meet another human being. Communication is more than correct answers; it is connection under pressure.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「A building that once divided people can later teach them about connection.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It is affected by design, habits, stress, and social pressure.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Information shared responsibly can help communities ask better questions and demand better answers.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Confidence must eventually meet another human being. Communication is more than correct answers; it is connection under pressure.」，答案為「Communication is more than correct answers; it is connection under pressure.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Communication is more than correct answers; it is connection under pressure.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
